cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Committee,

I am a computer engineer and lecturer who has spent the last few years building and evaluating NLP systems for medical and trustworthy AI. In my PhD work I created hybrid evaluation metrics for Turkish text summarisation and published a paper on human-centered evaluation of clinical AI models. Those projects required me to design benchmarks, compare model outputs with expert ratings, and test robustness to prompt changes, exactly the kind of work described for evaluating LLMs at Maki.

At Toros University I led the SmartLab Technology Center, where we built an LLM-as-judge system for Turkish summaries and measured agreement with human judges. This gave me practical experience in prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and bias analysis across languages. I also contributed to COST research networks focusing on AI-driven medical imaging, where I handled data pipelines and statistical validation.

My teaching background means I can explain technical findings clearly to both scientific peers and business stakeholders. While I have not formally studied psychometrics, I have applied reliability and validity concepts in my own research and look forward to deepening that knowledge.

I look forward to bringing my LLM evaluation expertise and commitment to transparent, fair AI to MakiPeople.

Best regards,
Anıl Kuş
